prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: catboost dominates both trend (corr=1.0) and seasonality (corr=0.9033) pattern alignment, but rf achieves the lowest overall RMSE (475.37). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (21.99) and high seasonality variance indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit decomposition-aware combination. Early/late horizon specialists differ (rf vs CWT_catboost), suggesting per-horizon weighting could further improve performance.
